status: illustrative planning scenario, not approved pricing, measured quality, demand forecast or Flash-Next equivalence

product_intent.lead: Question answering, synthesis across model knowledge and web sources, ideation and everyday search tasks
product_intent.later: Reploid-native autonomous agents with bounded tools, durable execution and budgets
product_intent.promise: Ask, explore and figure things out. Earn access by contributing useful computer resources, or pay as you go.
product_intent.search: Optional tool; invoke when useful, through an eligible authorized route rather than requiring paid search for every interaction.

sources.scope: Listed hosted model; not established equivalent to the deployed Flash-Next checkpoint
Extension-origin cross-origin requests and required host permissions

assumptions.original_rows_retrieval_route: paid API only; not a universal Reploid cost model

excluded_costs: additional model calls and reasoning tokens
interpretation: Search and inference are paid external bills in this comparator; substituting the mesh replaces inference with contributor and execution costs, not an additional duplicated inference bill.
No monthly subscription is implied by this one-time topup scenario.
The original rows apply only to paid-API retrieval.
Mixed-route remainder excludes all local/remote retrieval resource costs and is not profit.
Earned-credit redemption must fund actual external bills and service costs; no-fee retrieval reduces a potential bill but does not create funding.
Measure actual billable attempts including retries; the simple fallback fraction assumes one paid request per fallback and none on successful no-fee lookups.

retrieval_route_policy.selection: Choose among qualified routes within authorized recipients, access rules, deadline, cost and owner limits; fallback may not silently broaden disclosure or spending.
common_result_contract: actual attempts, billable calls and measured/unknown costs
retrieval_route_policy.privacy: Search providers receive queries; synthesis executors receive authorized evidence and context. Private browser sessions, credentials and authenticated content are not shared infrastructure by default.
retrieval_route_policy.cost_boundary: No per-query API fee is not zero cost. Include local/remote execution, bandwidth, hosting, maintenance, failed attempts and user intervention.
retrieval_route_policy.browser_boundary: An ordinary Reploid tab cannot generally read unrelated tabs or arbitrary origins. Extension cross-origin requests require host permissions in an appropriate extension context; native bridges require explicit authorization.
retrieval_route_policy.qualification: The 90% no-fee success rate is an assumption, not a measured route capability or savings claim.

existing: packages/reploid/src/retrieval/index.d.ts defines provider/extractor contracts with source URLs, timestamps, hashes, usage and errors
server/search/brave.js and server/search/searxng.js provide server adapters
not_established: installed requester extension or companion search route
qualified remote retrieval contributor path and associated rewards
measured no-fee success and paid fallback rates
source_inspection.scope: Source inspection only; no runtime tests or live provider requests in this update.

proof_journey: Freeze one investigation task, evidence requirements, answer quality policy, deadline and permissions.
Run it through requester-device retrieval plus authorized synthesis and record every attempt, source, error, fallback, intervention, latency and attributable cost.
Repeat against API-only retrieval under comparable conditions; compare evidence coverage and supported-answer quality, not just successful HTTP responses.
Use repeated representative investigations to estimate fallback rate and costs; a single successful journey proves integration only.
